title: Shibata’s return reaches the heavyweight summit
summary: Katsuyori Shibata fights his way back into New Japan’s central title picture. A New Japan Cup victory earns the defining championship challenge of this chapter against Okada.

chapters.title: Shibata wins the New Japan Cup
chapters.result: Shibata defeats Bad Luck Fale and challenges Okada.
chapters.context: The tournament gives the uncompromising challenger a direct path to the heavyweight championship.

chapters.title: Okada survives Shibata’s challenge
chapters.result: Okada defeats Shibata to retain the IWGP title.
chapters.context: Shibata’s real medical emergency after the match forced a long absence. That injury is distinct from the scripted championship rivalry and is not presented as a planned payoff.
